Synthetic fixtures of AzMaps' tests and its E2E (scripts/azmaps_nav_e2e.py). No personal data:
the places are public landmarks and stations.

takeout/        a Google Takeout folder as the export lays it out: "Saved Places.json",
                "Labeled places.json" and two "Saved" lists as CSV (one place without
                coordinates in its link, to be looked up and reviewed).
bookmarks.kmz   an Organic Maps style KMZ (a zip with doc.kml).
drive-berlin.nmea  an NMEA 0183 replay (GGA + RMC, one fix a second at 8.3 m/s) of a car drive
                from Berlin Hbf (Europaplatz) to Alexanderplatz along a public road route of
                OpenStreetMap, as FOSSGIS' Valhalla routes it.
